about: FCM HTTP v1 and Google OAuth responses for push/fcm.ts. `recorded` cases were captured from Google's servers on 2026-10-28 (fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/dreamstream-test/messages:send with no or a bogus bearer token; oauth2.googleapis.com/token with an unsigned assertion). `documented` cases follow Firebase's 'FCM error codes' (ErrorCode enum and the google.rpc error envelope) and need a real service account and device to record: re-record them in Phase 1 with the owner's Firebase project. `expect` is the outcome fcm.ts must map each to; for 401 cases fcm.ts first drops its OAuth token and retries once.

send.name: an access token Google refuses (revoked or expired)
